mf_offer.text: A man in a very good coat buys your coffee and mentions that his family is hiring. The benefits are excellent and the exit interview is not.

outcomes.in: He admires the nerve. You are in, with a signing envelope.
outcomes.out: He admires the nerve and stops returning your calls. Probably for the best.

mf_first_collection.text: Your first assignment is to collect an envelope from a dry cleaner. The owner is sweating through three shirts at once.

mf_shop_owner.text: A baker begs for one more month. His daughter is behind the counter, pretending not to listen.

outcomes.buy: The boss never checks. The baker names a pastry after you.
outcomes.caught: The boss checks. You pay the difference, in several ways.

mf_sitdown.text: The boss calls a sit-down at the back of a restaurant. Nobody has ordered, which is the worrying part.

outcomes.liked: The table likes the idea. Someone else gets the credit and you get the money.
outcomes.laughed: The table laughs for exactly one second too long.

mf_betrayal.text: A friend in the crew admits he has been skimming. He asks you not to mention it, then asks again.

outcomes.repays: He repays everything with interest and a sincere hug.
outcomes.flees: He disappears overnight. So does a suspicious amount of your cash.

mf_hit_order.text: The boss slides a photo across the table. It is a man you share a barbershop with, and nobody says what is expected, which makes it louder.

outcomes.tip: You warn the man to move to another state. He moves to another country.
outcomes.found: Someone else finishes the job and notes your hesitation.

mf_feds_deal.text: Two agents in cheap suits find you at a bus stop. They offer a deal: testify, disappear, live. They leave a card and a very patient silence.

outcomes.works: You feed both parties useful lies. For now.
outcomes.fails: Both parties learn about the other. Neither sends flowers.

mf_promotion.text: The captain taps your shoulder after dinner. There is an opening, a ring to kiss, and some paperwork nobody will write down.

mf_wedding.text: A made man's daughter is getting married and you are on the guest list, which is a polite word for the security detail.

outcomes.great: The room cries. Even the groom's uncle with the shotgun hobby.
outcomes.bad: You say 'sleeps with the fishes' about the cake. Awkward.

mf_rival_crew.text: A rival crew has been using your corner for business. The boss wants a message sent that is firm and legally boring.

outcomes.win: They back off. The cost is a broken window and a long month.
outcomes.lose: They answer in kind. You wake up with stitches and a lesson.

mf_skim.text: The count room is unsupervised for ten minutes. The cash is right there and the arithmetic is extremely tempting.

outcomes.clean: Nobody notices. You buy a watch you cannot wear in public.
outcomes.caught: They notice. Your fingers are spared, your reputation is not.

mf_capo_dinner.text: The captain hosts Sunday dinner. His mother asks you three questions, each one an interrogation with meatballs.

mf_boss_tribute.text: Envelopes arrive every Friday now. Everyone is very respectful and very frightened, and you suspect those are related.

outcomes.good: The pizza chain does well. Even the laundering is cheerful.
outcomes.bad: The front gets audited. So do you.

mf_witness.text: A kid saw something at the wrong dock at the wrong hour. The crew wants a decision before breakfast.

outcomes.safe: They leave by dawn and never ask why. You sleep better.
outcomes.found: Someone notices the van. Your name moves up a list you wanted off.

mf_retire.text: Your back hurts and your phone rings less. You consider the strange idea of a quiet life, in a quiet town, with quiet neighbors.

outcomes.blessed: They give a nod and a ham. You are free.
outcomes.refused: They tell you there is no leaving. A cake is mentioned.

bz_investor_pitch.text: A venture investor offers a seven-figure check and a board seat. The term sheet has more clauses than your product has features.

outcomes.win: He caves on everything but the beanbag chairs.
outcomes.walk: He walks. The beanbags remain unpaid.

bz_cfo_embezzle.text: Your CFO has been moving money to a company called 'Totally Real LLC'. His out-of-office reply is now just a boat emoji.

outcomes.recover: You recover most of it, plus an unregistered boat.
outcomes.lose: He is in a country with no extradition and a great cheese.

bz_viral_product.text: A random video makes your product famous overnight. Orders are crashing the servers, the warehouse, and your sense of calm.

outcomes.hit: The hoodie sells better than the product. Do not examine this.
outcomes.flop: The hoodie is a brief, soft failure.

bz_recall.text: A batch of your product is overheating in a small number of kitchens. Legal says the word 'recall'. Marketing says anything else.

outcomes.works: The patch works. Nobody ever speaks of it again.
outcomes.burn: The news finds out. The headline is not flattering.

bz_union.text: Your employees want to unionize. The slogans are catchy and the demands are mostly about chairs.

outcomes.deal: Everyone gets better chairs. Productivity oddly improves.
outcomes.strike: A short strike. A very long cold coffee.

bz_ipo_offer.text: Bankers in matching vests propose taking your company public. They use the word 'unlock' eleven times in one slide.

outcomes.hot: The market loves you. Your face is briefly on a banner.
outcomes.cold: The market shrugs and so do you.

bz_bankruptcy.text: Cash runs short before payroll. The spreadsheet has a cell highlighted red, and then a second one, and then a column.

outcomes.win: The client signs. You exhale for the first time in a month.
outcomes.lose: The client ghosts you. The lights go off in order.

bz_rival_poach.text: A rival offers your best engineer double her salary. She mentions it to you before replying, as a courtesy and a threat.

outcomes.stays: She stays and she is very, very happy about the cap table.
outcomes.leaves: She leaves and takes the cat mug.

bz_audit.text: The tax authorities request a lengthy meeting about 'certain expenses'. Your accountant develops a new nervous cough.

outcomes.fine: A modest fine and a firm handshake.
outcomes.heavy: A heavy fine and a firm look.

bz_acquisition.text: A giant corporation sends a bouquet and an acquisition offer. The bouquet is nicer than the offer.

outcomes.war: Two giants fight over you. You do the spreadsheets in a hot tub.

bz_scandal.text: A leaked memo shows your company dumped waste in a river whose fish are now unionizing. The board wants a statement.

outcomes.works: The intern is promoted to an unpaid advisory role. The press moves on.
outcomes.fails: The intern speaks to the press. Beautifully.

bz_supply_crisis.text: A key supplier folds. Your shelves are empty and your customers are polite in the way that precedes leaving.

outcomes.good: Eighteen months later you control your own destiny and some forklifts.
outcomes.bad: Eighteen months later you control a warehouse of regret.

bz_pivot.text: Your product is not selling, but a side feature is. An advisor suggests pivoting with the confidence of someone who will not be present.

outcomes.great: Both lines grow. The whiteboard is full of arrows.
outcomes.mess: Neither line grows. The whiteboard is full of other arrows.

bz_patent_suit.text: A competitor claims you copied their patent. Your lawyer describes the case as 'colorful' in an unhelpful voice.

outcomes.win: The judge rules for you and then for lunch.
outcomes.lose: The judge rules for them and also for lunch.

sp_knee_injury.text: Mid-play, your knee makes a sound like a snapped pencil. The crowd goes quiet, then gives you a mournful, generous ovation.

outcomes.full: Weeks of dull rehab restore you almost entirely.
outcomes.partial: The knee heals, but not the way it used to.

sp_sprain.text: You roll your ankle in warm-ups. The team doctor calls it 'minor' in the tone of a man selling you a second opinion.

outcomes.fine: It heals quickly. You decline to thank the ice.
outcomes.worse: It gets worse. The ice remains smug.

sp_trade_rumor.text: Reporters whisper you are about to be traded. You hear this while standing in line at a bakery, which somehow stings more.

outcomes.stay: They keep you and double your locker space.
outcomes.traded: Traded to a city with excellent soup and a weaker team.

sp_doping_temptation.text: A trainer offers a 'recovery supplement' with no label. He swears it is mostly vitamins and entirely undetectable.

outcomes.clean: You feel unstoppable and the tests agree. For now.
outcomes.caught: The test catches it. The lab technician looks sorry for you.

sp_championship.text: It is the championship game, tied, final seconds. Eighty thousand people are holding their breath and some are holding their nachos.

outcomes.win: The ball goes in. The stadium erupts. You do a very modest wave.
outcomes.miss: The ball hits the rim, thinks about it, and leaves.

sp_retirement_pressure.text: The coach says 'legacy' a lot. The team physician says 'longevity'. Your own body says nothing and just sighs.

outcomes.title: You win it, quietly the best chapter of your career.
outcomes.flop: You get benched in the second half and the cameras notice.

sp_contract.text: Your contract expires. Three teams call, each offering more money and a worse mascot.

outcomes.win: They cave. You win a very public parade of money.
outcomes.lose: They sign someone else and you sit.

sp_endorsement.text: A drink company offers you an endorsement. You must hold the bottle with the label out and smile like you love it.

outcomes.yes: They agree. You also receive a lifetime supply of the drink.

sp_fan_incident.text: A fan tackles you for a selfie after the game. Security reacts like it is a heist film.

outcomes.clip: Someone films it. You look dignified and slightly tragic.
outcomes.viral: The clip goes viral. You look ruder than intended.

sp_coach_clash.text: Your coach benches you without explanation. He then explains it for forty minutes using a whiteboard and a sports metaphor.

outcomes.prove: You score twice. He pretends he planned it.
outcomes.flop: You trip over a cone. The cone gets a mention.

sp_comeback.text: After a long layoff, the team offers a comeback tryout. Your muscles file a formal complaint.

outcomes.make: You make the roster, sweating like a person in a sauna.
outcomes.cut: You are cut after an elegant, awkward stumble.

sp_rival.text: A younger rival keeps outscoring you and says nice things about you in interviews, which is the worst part.

outcomes.win: You win by a nose. The nose is somehow in the highlight reel.
outcomes.lose: You lose and the press prints a haiku about it.

as_selection.text: A spokesperson announces the program has ten thousand applicants and room for a dozen. Your folder is stamped with a very polite 'maybe'.

outcomes.liked: The panel laughs. You advance with a slightly nervous grin.
outcomes.flat: The panel does not. You advance anyway, by mistake.

as_centrifuge.text: The centrifuge spins up to nine g. Your cheeks migrate to the rear of your skull and your lunch makes its own plans.

outcomes.good: You hold your vision. The instructor nods with the enthusiasm of a statue.
outcomes.black: You black out and wake to cheerful applause.

as_washout_exam.text: Final qualification exam: sixty procedures, four systems, one examiner staring at his watch like it owes him money.

outcomes.pass: You pass. The examiner shakes your hand and says 'adequate'.
outcomes.fail: You wash out. The chair feels very large afterward.

as_launch_day.text: Launch day. You sit in a seat the size of a recliner, strapped to several thousand tons of controlled optimism.

outcomes.success: The countdown hits zero. The sky opens, then closes behind you, and everything is quiet.
outcomes.abort: An alarm sounds and the launch scrubs. You climb out, shaky and philosophical.
outcomes.death: A booster fails seconds after liftoff. The radio goes silent.

as_spacewalk.text: You float out the airlock. Earth hangs below, enormous, blue, and wildly unconcerned with your repairs.

outcomes.fixed: The fix holds. Mission control cheers in a surprisingly high register.
outcomes.tangle: Your tether tangles, then un-tangles. Your pulse does not.
outcomes.drift: A glove snags and you drift. The rescue is a close thing.

as_moon_mission.text: You are chosen for the first crewed lunar landing in decades. The press conference has more flags than people.

outcomes.landing: You step onto gray dust and say something nearly profound.
outcomes.abort: The landing is scrubbed in orbit. Disappointing, but alive.
outcomes.lost: The lander fails to return. The crew's names go on a wall.

as_reentry.text: Re-entry. The capsule glows orange and the window shows only fire. A calm voice reads numbers that are mostly reassuring.

outcomes.safe: The parachutes bloom. You land with a thud and a sunburned grin.
outcomes.hard: The landing is hard. Your back has opinions for a month.
outcomes.lost: The heat shield fails. The calm voice stops.

as_docking.text: Docking with the station requires aligning two enormous objects at walking pace. A single sneeze would be a diplomatic incident.

outcomes.good: Perfect docking. Applause echoes in your helmet.
outcomes.bump: A small bump. A large embarrassment.

as_isolation.text: Month four of the mission. The crew has started naming the dust. You are fond of a speck called Gerald.

outcomes.laugh: He laughs for a full minute. Morale surges.
outcomes.mad: He does not laugh. Morale holds a funeral.

as_fire_alarm.text: A fire alarm sounds at 3 a.m. station time. Someone's laundry is hot, smoky, and apologetic.

outcomes.ok: The fire dies. You remain alive and slightly embarrassed.
outcomes.bad: The fix works but the cabin loses air. A long night follows.
outcomes.worse: The vent jams. The mission ends in a long silence.

as_homecoming_press.text: You land to a mob of cameras. A reporter asks if you are 'a hero'. Another asks if you saw any aliens.

as_call_home.text: You call home from orbit. A kid asks if you can see their house. You say yes, which is almost true.

ag_tail.text: A gray sedan has followed you for three blocks. It has either a very bad driver or a very good one.

outcomes.friend: It is just a delivery driver with excellent taste in music.
outcomes.foe: It is an opposing agent. Both of you pretend to be lost.

ag_double_agent.text: A cold-eyed colleague in your own agency has been selling secrets. You discover it while reading his shopping list.

outcomes.works: The trap works and he cries into his tea.
outcomes.fails: The trap fails and so does your alias.

ag_honeypot.text: A charming stranger at the hotel bar knows your favorite drink and no other details. The candlelight feels engineered.

outcomes.works: They are an operative too. You swap cover stories over dessert.
outcomes.burnt: They wake you with a camera. Someone is in trouble, and it is you.

ag_interrogation.text: You are in a windowless room with a metal table and an officer who has clearly watched many films.

outcomes.good: They release you with a bag of snacks and a headache.
outcomes.bad: They see through it. Your file just got louder.

ag_extraction.text: An asset must be extracted from a hostile capital in one hour. The only map is a drawing by a child.

outcomes.success: You exit with the asset and a surprisingly good stew.
outcomes.close: You get out but the asset does not. The debrief is long.
outcomes.blown: A patrol finds you. Your cover cracks like a cheap plate.

ag_dead_drop.text: The dead drop is inside a hollow tree in a public park. A man on a bench is feeding pigeons. Both are suspicious.

outcomes.clean: You grab it. The pigeons are unmoved.
outcomes.trap: The package has glitter in it. So do you.

ag_safehouse.text: The safehouse is a cheap apartment with a fake bookshelf, a real cat, and an alarm that plays classical music.

outcomes.clear: Nothing. Just a cat watching you pay your bills.
outcomes.found: You find three. Two are yours.

ag_gadget.text: Quartermaster issues you a pen that is a camera, a watch that is a laser, and a laser that is a pen.

outcomes.great: It works perfectly. A passerby claps.
outcomes.oops: It sets a menu on fire. You pay for the menu.

ag_promotion.text: The director hands you a folder with no label. Inside is a promotion and a very small plant.

ag_handler_burned.text: Your handler stops answering. His last message reads 'Pizza?' which is not the code word for anything.

outcomes.found: You find him on a ferry, safe and embarrassed.
outcomes.trap: It was a trap. Your cover gets very warm.

ag_gala.text: A black-tie gala hides your target behind eighty candles and a string quartet. You are wearing someone else's shoes.

outcomes.works: A charming chat and a convenient napkin.
outcomes.spilled: You spill a tray. The napkin is the least of your worries.

ag_slip.text: At a dinner party, you nearly say your real name. The sentence comes out as a long cough.

outcomes.save: They assume it's a pet name. Your cover lives.
outcomes.bust: Someone writes it down. Your cover does not live.
